title: Slain Loyola student Sheridan Gorman’s mother gifts Congress bench dedicated to her daughter at GOP midterm convention
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

DALLAS — Angel mother Jessica Gorman unveiled a new bench at the GOP midterm convention that will be given to Congress in dedication to her daughter, Sheridan, who was murdered by an illegal immigrant.

Follow The Post’s live updates of the 2026 Republican National Convention

The bench was crafted by a law enforcement officer in North Carolina who spent some 200 hours hand-crafting the bench.

“May this bench remind us to see those who feel alone, to choose kindness and to remember every life that leaves an empty seat,” an inscription on the bench read.

After showing off the bench, Gorman invited Rep. Mike Lawler to be the first to sit on it on stage.

This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
